H2_calibration.quote: Several of the constitutional points (vagueness, due process, ex post facto, First Amendment reach of "develop") will need a litigator's assessment before being relied on.
H2_calibration.note: Generic caveat; see H2 specific below

H1_holdback.quote: publicly pointing to an exploitable loophole invites the Committee to close it with a second manager's amendment, while pointing to vagueness and unworkability tends to slow the bill. Legal and policy should decide which items go in the public-facing material versus the internal contingency memo.

H4_grandfather_step.quote: Developers can begin as many large runs as they can stand up before signature, and nothing in the text requires those runs to be bona fide or complete.
